description: `--output json cli run --help` prints the group's help and every run command's manifest record, as service.operations.

result.help:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli run <COMMAND> [ARGUMENTS] [OPTIONS]

Commands:
  submit                      Run a program on the hosted service and stream it until it finishes, detaches or the deadline passes.
  watch                       Replay and follow a live run's events from a sequence number.
  show                        Show a run manifest (status, files, price), or one output file with --file.
  list                        List runs, newest first, one page at a time.
  cancel                      Cancel a live run, then report the wallet's available and reserved balance.
  download                    Download every file listed in a run manifest into a new directory (./RUN_ID unless --output-dir).
  input                       Send an instruction to a live run.
  quote                       Report the hold a run reserves: money set aside from the wallet while the run is live.
  share                       Create a public link to a run's outputs.

Examples:
  prose cli run submit hello.prose.md --preview
  prose cli run watch run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c --json
  prose cli run show run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c --json
  prose cli run list --limit 10 --json
  prose cli run cancel run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c --preview
  prose cli run download run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c
  prose cli run input run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c 'Also write a haiku.' --yes
  prose cli run quote --json
  prose cli run share run_4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c4f1c2d3e4f5a6b7c --yes

Global options:
  --output human|json|jsonl   Output mode; the same as the PROSE_OUTPUT setting.

Run `prose cli run <COMMAND> --help` for details. `prose cli service operations --json` prints every command as JSON.

operations.summary:
Report the hold a run reserves: money set aside from the wallet while the run is live. It is not the price. The environment is checked first.
The hold is flat, the same for every program and model, and what the run does not use is released when it settles. A run's price is known only after it settles (`cli run show RUN_ID`, price_cents). The program, inputs and model `cli run submit` takes are accepted, so you can quote the exact command you will submit.

arguments.description: Program file, or - for standard input. Omit when --from is given.
arguments.name: FILE

operations.confirmReason: it starts a paid run: a hold (money set aside from the wallet, not the price) is reserved now, and the run's price is charged when it settles
examples: prose cli run submit --from exowner1/hello --input topic=rain --yes --detach --json

operations.summary:
Run a program on the hosted service and stream it until it finishes, detaches or the deadline passes.
Inputs: --input KEY=VALUE overrides the same key from --inputs-file.
A --wait shorter than the run exits 21 with details.resumeArgv: the run continues, and that command follows it again. Never submit again to resume; that starts a second paid run.

operations.summary:
Show a run manifest (status, files, price), or one output file with --file. Signed file URLs are never printed.
The manifest has no final response text. Read the run's outputs with `cli run show RUN_ID --file outputs/result.json` or `cli run download RUN_ID --output-dir DIR`; replay the stream, whose terminal event carries the response, with `cli run watch RUN_ID --after 0` (runs submitted from this machine, or pass --session).

Create a public link to a run's outputs. Anyone with the link can open it for 24 hours, and it cannot be revoked.
To give specific people access instead, invite them to your organization (`cli org invite`).
